svg.title: Money comes in layers
svg.desc: An upside-down pyramid of six layers. From the top: shares, property and crypto; bonds and T-bills; offshore and private dollars; bank deposits; central bank money; and gold at the base. Each layer is a promise to pay in the layer below.
